summary: A dense focus-mode toolbar that restyles Button, IconButton and Kbd with component tokens on one wrapper: tighter gap and line-height, a regular-weight large button, wider small padding, a borderless ghost button, a 36px icon button and a square keycap.
use: A product whose design system fixes button weight, tracking, gap, padding and keycap size per context (public area, dashboard, focus mode), without writing selectors against ca-* classes.
spec: `<Button variant="filled" size="lg">` labelled Call next lead
`<Button variant="outlined" tone="neutral" size="sm">` labelled Snooze, a ghost neutral sm Skip and a disabled outlined neutral sm Reassign
`<IconButton variant="text" size="sm" aria-label="Close focus mode">` with an X icon
`<Kbd>N</Kbd>` after the text Next lead in a `.hint` span
Flex `.dense` wrapper with `gap: var(--ca-space-3)`; the CSS has no selector against a component class
